label: escalate: POSH process
message: A colleague keeps sending me inappropriate messages on WhatsApp late at night. What can I do?

response.answer:
This sounds like it may involve sexual harassment. I can't assess what happened or take a complaint, but you can speak to the Internal Committee in confidence. Internal Committee (POSH): ic@nexora.example. You can also talk to the Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): 1800-000-0000 (extension 9), 24x7, confidential. If you are in immediate danger, call 112.

What the POSH Policy says about the process:
You can raise the matter under the POSH policy because unwanted sexual messages on a personal device are covered as workplace conduct [S1]. You may first speak to a member of the Internal Committee for guidance and request interim relief; a formal complaint is not required if you only want the behaviour to stop [S1]. If you choose to file a formal complaint, it must be made within three months of the incident, though the Committee can extend this by another three months for valid reasons [S1]. The process is confidential and your manager will be informed only as needed for interim measures [S1].

citations.document: Policy on Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH)
citations.snippet: For example, unwelcome sexual messages from a colleague on a personal messaging application at 11 p.m. on a Sunday are within this Policy.
citations.label: POSH Policy, p. 11, cl. C.1
